summary: Comprehensive testing of OpenClaw SaaS platform completed. All 37 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed including login, register, dashboard, campaigns, leads, agents, messages, analytics, settings, and AI composer. The platform is fully functional with beautiful cyberpunk dark UI design.

issues: Console warning about chart dimensions (-1 width/height) - cosmetic only, charts render correctly

critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
JWT auth working correctly with proper 401 responses for unauthorized requests
Multi-tenancy data isolation verified - different orgs cannot see each other's data
AI generation via Gemini 3 Flash working correctly for multiple languages
SendGrid email and Twilio WhatsApp gracefully fall back to MOCK status as expected (unverified sender / SK key)
seed_data_creation: Demo data is automatically seeded on user registration including 12 leads, 4 agents (Atlas, Nyx, Orion, Vega), 4 campaigns, activity feed, and sample messages
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs and frontend UI flows are working correctly. The platform uses JWT authentication, MongoDB for data storage, and Gemini 3 Flash for AI message generation. SendGrid email and Twilio WhatsApp are configured but fall back to MOCK status due to unverified sender and SK key (not AC Account SID). This is expected behavior as documented.

mocked_integrations.SendGrid: Falls back to MOCK status - sender email not verified
mocked_integrations.Twilio WhatsApp: Falls back to MOCK status - SK key provided instead of AC Account SID
